headword: {読売新聞|よみうりしんぶん}

definitions.explanation: A Tokyo-based national daily newspaper with the largest circulation in Japan. Often called {読売|よみうり} for short. The same media group owns the Yomiuri Giants baseball team.

examples.japanese: うち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読売新聞|よみうりしんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}っている→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: We take the Yomiuri at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{読売新聞|よみうりしんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: My father reads the Yomiuri Shimbun every morning.

examples.japanese: {読売新聞|よみうりしんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世論調査|よろんちょうさ}→世論調査：16942_yoronchousa⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支持率|しじりつ}→支持率：17086_shijiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: According to a Yomiuri Shimbun poll, the cabinet's approval rating has fallen.

notes:
